name: Захист від мату: взяття
description:
Sometimes, attack is the best defence. You simply take the attacker.

Do you need to prevent a checkmate? Try to capture the attacking piece. With a bit a luck, you even win points. See example 1.

Taking the attacker does not always work. But sometimes it helps to capture another piece. This is shown in example 2.

What do you have to do?
Defend against checkmate by capturing a piece.

examples.text:
Black threatens mate on the first row.
White sees the danger. His knight takes the rook.
No mate and a 5 point profit.
Easy!

Black’s rook wants to checkmate on the green square.
White cannot take the attacker.
An X-ray defence with the rook is useless.
White’s rook can follow the red arrow to defend the (green) mating square.
But Black has two rooks for his mating plan. He can use either one.

White has no choice. He has to capture one of the rooks.
The white rook takes the black rook that guards the white king in his prison.
Now checkmate is out of the way.
